hook: Your breakfast has a backup copy inside a frozen mountain.
title: The Vault Inside a Frozen Arctic Mountain
description:
The Svalbard Global Seed Vault in Norway stores backup seeds from around the world inside a mountain in the Arctic. The cold helps keep them safe for the long term. It works like an insurance policy for the world's food crops.

#Shorts #Geography #Norway
comment_prompt: Which seed would you save? Rice or wheat

scenes.headline: SVALBARD SEED VAULT

scenes.narration: It sits deep in the Arctic, near the North Pole.
scenes.headline: DEEP IN THE ARCTIC

scenes.narration: Inside, seeds from around the world are stored.

scenes.narration: Crops like rice and wheat are kept safe there.
